covered.rule: A §2 call variables (title + last name)

A2 "Am I speaking with {title} {last_name}?"

A4 robot/AI reply

A6 callback today/next business day 10:00-19:00 inclusive, after now; not_reached/callback
A7 ask once for another time; not_reached/no_callback
A8 wrong number
A9 deceased: "I am sorry for your loss."
A10 relative may not answer security questions / be told anything
A11 DOB then phone last 4, DOB as YYYY-MM-DD, numeric dates read d/m/y
A12 three wrong answers in total
A13 day_month_swapped hint, say month as a word, not counted
A14 mobile app or branch; not_verified/failed
A15 explain once; not_verified/declined; asking purpose counts as decline
A16-17 get_account, collections team about late payment, product naming
A §7 business days and holidays
A18 band table (1-7 early 12th bd, 1 attempt; 8-45 late 7th bd, 2 attempts)
A19-21, A23 date validity, weekend/holiday roll forward, vague ask once then deadline, after deadline offer deadline
A22 next/this weekday
A24 full first, never ask how much
A25 floors per product type
A26-27 floor once, rest stays overdue, accept between floor and full
A28 "Can you make this payment today?"
A30 attempt 1 last business day this week/next, attempt 2 floor on deadline
A31 no_promise/refused
A32 hardship: sympathy, offer support transfer, else no_promise/hardship, before persuasion, may still record promise
A33 no discount/waiver/plan

B2 state every product before asking
